source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 29ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Ησύχιος ο Σιναΐτης»

attestations.note: One sentence: «Ο Όσιος Ησύχιος έζησε τον 7ο αιώνα μ.Χ. και διετέλεσε ηγούμενος της μονής Σινά. Κοιμήθηκε οσίως με ειρήνη.» No hymn, no relic, no writing named. He is a different man from the Hesychius of Jerusalem whom the same calendar keeps on 28 March, who was a presbyter of the fifth century in Palestine and not an abbot of Sinai in the seventh.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Ησύχιος έζησε τον 7ο αιώνα μ.Χ.» The page gives no year for his birth and none for his repose, so the interval recorded is the century it names.
